verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy-posture question for a cloud-hosted coding agent like Devin. Nothing in the evidence pack documents retention periods, deletion of sessions or data, or any user-facing privacy controls. The cited docs cover sessions, MCP, scheduling, knowledge and environments, none of which is about retention, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
